response.rationale: The recipe's first step is 'docker build -t <your-astro-image-name> .' (building the image). The second step is 'docker run -p <local-port>:<container-port> <your-astro-image-name>', which the artifact describes as running the image as a local container, with the -p flag mapping a local port to the container's exposed port. This matches option 3; it does not upload to a cloud provider (that is mentioned only as a later deployment step) and does not build or tag the image.
